name: Grand Mercure Bali Seminyak
short_description: A 269-room seaside hotel on Jalan Arjuna in Seminyak, with three lagoon-style pools, a Lagoon Bar, and design blending Balinese artistry with modern comfort.
ai_summary: Grand Mercure Bali Seminyak sits on Jalan Arjuna in Seminyak, blending Balinese artistry with modern comfort across 269 rooms and suites. Three lagoon-style pools anchor the resort, connected by a swim-up Lagoon Bar, alongside a premium spa and multiple dining venues. Guests consistently praise the pool complex, central Seminyak location near the area's shopping and dining strip, and private suite options with their own plunge pools, making it a popular pick for both couples and families.

core_facts.address: Jl. Arjuna No. 40, Seminyak, Kuta 80361, Bali, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Three lagoon-style pools connected by a swim-up Lagoon Bar
Central Seminyak location on Jalan Arjuna, near the area's shopping and dining strip
Private suite options with their own plunge pools
Premium spa and multiple on-site dining venues
Design blends Balinese artistry with modern comfort throughout
cons: Seminyak's popularity means more traffic and crowds than Bali's quieter resort areas
As a larger hotel, the atmosphere leans more resort-scale than boutique
research_highlights: The three-pool lagoon complex and swim-up bar are consistently praised
The Seminyak location is repeatedly called convenient for shopping and dining
Private-pool suites draw specific praise from couples seeking more privacy
research_watchouts: Seminyak's traffic and crowds are a genuine consideration during peak season

faqs.question: Does Grand Mercure Bali Seminyak have private pools?
faqs.answer: Some suite categories include their own private plunge pools, in addition to the resort's three shared lagoon-style pools connected by a swim-up Lagoon Bar.

faqs.question: Is Grand Mercure Bali Seminyak close to Seminyak's shopping strip?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's located on Jalan Arjuna in the heart of Seminyak, within easy reach of the area's boutiques, restaurants, and beach clubs.
